name: Osteoblast
short_description: Cuboidal-to-columnar, matrix-bound bone-forming cell that lines the surface of growing/remodeling bone in a single epithelioid layer; intensely basophilic cytoplasm packed with rough ER and a prominent Golgi zone, secreting type I collagen and other osteoid proteins that it then mineralises with calcium. Once it walls itself inside its own matrix it becomes an osteocyte.
